question: The value of (32 div 4 - 5 times 8 div 3)/(5 times 3 - {6 + 3\)} is:
solution:
Concept Used: 

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d5d53fbef7cb246c82384c70b63b0287aa26f6cdb11ad3d427215025057797.png] 

Calculation:

(32 ÷ 4 - 5 × 8 ÷ 3)/(5 × 3 - {6 + 3\)}

⇒ (8 – 5 × 8 ÷ 3)/(5 × 3 – 9)

⇒ (8 – 5 × 8/3)/(15 – 9)

⇒ (8 – 40/3)/6

⇒ (24 – 40)/3/6

⇒ (-16/3)/6

⇒ -16/18

⇒ -8/9

**∴ The required value is -(8)/(9).**

16
